description: Environment setup - install dependencies, run type-check, and ensure existing tests pass to establish a green baseline before making changes.
steps: Run `bun install` to install all dependencies
Run `bun run type-check` and capture the result (there may be pre-existing type errors - note them)
Run `bun run test:run` to verify existing tests pass
Run `bun run lint` to check linting status
Report findings so subsequent features know what the baseline looks like
